commentary_segments.text: After the noise analysis of the single-transistor configurations, we now consider the two-transistor configurations. A current mirror is taken first now, followed by differential pairs. We already know that a current source transistor should be designed with large V −V or small GS T W/L. Let us see whether this applies to all current sources and mirrors.
